items.title: Oura’s $2.2B IPO is mostly a payday for existing shareholders
items.summary: Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake in Oura for as much as $1.26 billion, according to Oura's latest IPO filing.

items.title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
items.summary: Tabby is designed to be a real-time bookkeeping interface, handling clients’ paperwork as it gives them up-to-the-minute data on their business’s profit and loss.
